page.content:
Columbia observatory where Tharp and Heezen mapped the seafloor.

How Lamont–Doherty Earth Observatory connects

  • Character: Marie Tharp — Tharp mapped the ocean floor at Lamont.
  • Character: Bruce Heezen — Heezen was a Lamont marine geologist.

What is Lamont–Doherty Earth Observatory?

Lamont–Doherty, then the Lamont Geological Observatory, held the echo-sounding archive Tharp turned into the first complete physiographic map of the oceans.

Key threads lead to Marie Tharp and Bruce Heezen.
